prompts.DoubleWins:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a standalone square transparent PNG icon for a Roblox fishing game's paid shop, aimed at 13-year-old players. Target 1024x1024. Clean bold cartoon game-item illustration, playful but not babyish, slightly dimensional cel shading, very thick smooth dark navy outlines, simple chunky shapes, soft upper-left highlights, subtle contact shading only inside the object. A single centered object or tightly unified small group, entire silhouette inside the central 70% of the canvas (at least 15% transparent padding on every side), very legible at 64px. No background, no panel, no badge border, no floor, no cast shadow outside subject, no surrounding glow, no watermark, no faces or characters, no currency symbols or Roblox logo, no photographic texture, no tiny details. True alpha transparency, not a checkerboard illustration. Coherent rich jewel colors, warm gold highlights. Only the two multiplier icons may contain the exact large symbol ×2; other icons have no text, numerals or lettering.
Image 1 is the existing DoubleWins icon to REVISE. Keep its simple polished cartoon game-icon style, dark navy outlines, strong silhouette, warm highlights and large white ×2 treatment. Replace the entire gold coin stack with a single thick bundle of vivid green PAPER CASH banknotes, shown in a clear 3/4 view. Banknotes must be unmistakably rectangular green paper notes with visible stacked paper edges, a simple lighter-green inset rectangle and blank central oval. A simple gold/orange paper band wraps around the bundle; no bow and no ribbon tails. Keep the large white exact ×2 outlined dark navy at the lower front. ABSOLUTELY NO COINS and no metallic circular objects. No currency symbols, dollar signs, denominations, portraits, real banknote design, other text or logos. A compact icon with at least 15% empty transparent margin on all four sides. Transparent background, 1024x1024 target. Friendly, crisp, appealing to a 13-year-old Roblox player.
